ctx.x: No. They used to load them on ships. You understand? Yes. But they never made nothing of it because I don't think there was enough of New Orleans boys would go on that ship. You understand? I guess if there was a thousand or maybe five hundred boys from New Orleans was going on that ship to go abroad. Well there's no doubt that they would give them a sand off with a band. But there wasn't enough from here.
I was going to ask about a couple of fellas that played with Jack Lane. Do you remember Dave Perkins?
